conflicting_evidence: Alibaba's most advanced video generation model, supporting over 10 visual creation capabilities in a unified system. Wan 2.6 generates 1080p video at 24fps from text, images, reference videos, or audio, with native audio-visual synchronization and precise lip-sync. Key features include reference-to-video (insert a character's appearance and voice into new scenes), multi-shot storytelling from simple prompts, synchronized sound effects and music, and support for 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 aspect ratios with clips up to 15 seconds.
